provider: Indian Space Research Organisation (ISRO) / Indian Space Science Data Centre (ISSDC)
citation: Chowdhury, A. et al. (2020). Orbiter High Resolution Camera (OHRC) on Chandrayaan-2: High resolution imaging of the lunar surface. Current Science, 118(4), 548-555.

OHRC.spatial_resolution_mpp: 0.25 m to 0.32 m per pixel at 100 km orbit
OHRC.significance: Finest spatial resolution lunar orbital civilian camera; resolves boulders down to 0.5m diameter.

TMC-2.type: Three-line stereo pushbroom scanner (Fore, Nadir, Aft)
TMC-2.significance: Generates high-precision digital elevation models across polar strips [-70 deg to -90 deg].

cataloged_polar_products.target_region: Simpelius N / Boguslawsky South Pole Transition Corridor
cataloged_polar_products.usage_notes: Provides extreme resolution context for boulder distribution in the 70°S-75°S context corridor.
High-resolution verification of crater morphology and boulder ejecta in the 75°S-80°S extended corridor.

cataloged_polar_products.target_region: South Pole Highland Extended Corridor (-70° to -80°)
cataloged_polar_products.usage_notes: Stereo triplet DTM providing elevation, slope, and roughness for regions poleward of 70°S where 80m LOLA polar DEM has coarse coverage.

cataloged_polar_products.target_region: South Pole Polar Core Corridor (-80° to -90°)
cataloged_polar_products.usage_notes: Independent stereo validation of LOLA Product 78/90 altimetry models.
